parsedVerdict.reasoning: The three files form one coherent infrastructure adapter layer. http-server.ts is the HTTP adapter, in-memory-task-repository.ts is the persistence adapter implementing the domain TaskRepository port, and server.ts is the process entry point. Every route in createApp goes through TaskService methods and never touches the repository or entities directly. Each rule lives in one place: error-to-status mapping (statusCode plus the single error middleware), request body parsing (bodyOf/stringField) and task filtering (tasksForProject). There are minor local repeats: server.ts repeats the port fallback expression, and http-server.ts calls stringField several times for the same field. These are small in-file redundancies, not an invariant split across files or a bypassed abstraction. The 'as TaskStatus' casts skip validation in the adapter, but whether the application or domain validates status values is not visible here.
